limitations: These are proposal results, not completed workflows or authorization/execution rates.
New diagnostics and fixes are post-output development; any cached replay is regression evidence, never fresh acceptance or changed original scores.
The dataset remains a correlated synthetic diagnostic candidate with unresolved semantic family separation and complete public-checkpoint lineage.
The reviewer observed evaluation outputs only after sealing the independent gold receipt; that receipt and its predeclared24case sensitivity remain unchanged.

new_probe_status.purpose: Expected red specification before the integration owner fixes planner and summaries; fresh synthetic entities, no frozen cases/results imported.

root_causes.cause: Broad AS identity regex mistakes self-attribution or request/media-class phrases for a foreign identity. It rejects as a request, as my request, as me, and as a TV-series request.
Explicit artist relationship detector omits whose performer is. General equals-sign labels are also false abstentions in new diagnostic probes.

Both runtimes replace validated unsafe/complex controls when lexical guards miss, and overwrite clarify slots heuristically. Product-style repeated verification further erodes a first boundary control; conditional complex becomes a reference clarification.

Scope detector removes arbitrary model entity strings before checking restrictions. A model album equal to track plus a number removes the actual selector from the unquoted instruction. Exact lookup could then resolve an unrelated album with that name.
Sixteen explicit resuming requests become torrent_list; one current-activity request becomes history because a negated history noun is treated as positive.

Presence of a negated request word promotes a correct movie inventory read to request_status in released code; the improved request qualifier guard then clarifies. Neither preserves the affirmative library read.

Twelve artist/album role mistakes and one filename error survive as reads; eight special-inclusive reads lose specials, eight paused filters and two stalled filters lose their intended state. These are not new damages introduced by this change.

strict_control_and_predeclared_sensitivi.note: No additional post-output alternatives are accepted.
